info.description: Offline fallback — live Init is patches/init.json

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB, slider −120…0 dB with −18 dB at the middle). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

frequency.tooltip: Pitch of the comb: delay D = fs/f (fractional). When ƒ is wired, that Hz is the pitch (absolute). Unwired uses this knob (Hz).

decay.tooltip: Feedback only: wall-clock seconds for the loop envelope to fall to 1/e. g = exp(−D/(τ·fs)) with D = fs/f. Hold ≈ undamped. Unused in Feedforward.

hold.tooltip: Feedback only: g ≈ 1 (sustained loop), partials above Low Cut ring forever. DC cannot pile up: with + polarity the loop subtracts the mean of its last period (exact for every harmonic, so pitch and Decay are untouched).

damping.tooltip: Feedback only: one-pole lowpass in the loop (Karplus–Strong style). 0 = bright pure comb, 1 = dark / faster high-partial loss.

lowCut.tooltip: Highpass on the input (one-pole), before the comb: the bottom edge of what excites it (Damping trims the top). Low partials get less to ring with, so the comb sounds thinner. It is outside the loop, so it never changes pitch or Decay. At the bottom of its range it only keeps DC out.

topology.tooltip: Feedback = recursive comb (resonates / can sustain). Feedforward = FIR color only (notches/peaks, no self-resonance).

invert.tooltip: + = delayed term added (peaks at k·f). − = subtracted (peaks at odd half-multiples).

depth.tooltip: Feedforward only: amount of delayed input mixed in (0 = dry, 1 = full comb color). Ignored in Feedback.

rate.tooltip: Clock rate in Hz. Wired ƒ cancels Rate (absolute Hz), same as oscillators.

pulseStart.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes high. Quantized to whole samples.

pulseEnd.tooltip: Where in the cycle the gate goes low. Quantized to whole samples.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides.

morph.tooltip: 0…1 width/duty. 0.5 = center / 50%. Affects Trisaw, Analog Square (same-direction peaks), Trisaw Center (opposing peaks toward saw), Pulse, and Center Square (pulse grows from mid-cycle — not a stepped square). Morph MOD jack on the param row.

amplitude.tooltip: Output level. Slider 0…1 = full-scale bipolar wave. Post-MOD stays in min…max (Gate+Toggle cannot boost past Amp max).

aa.tooltip: Antialiasing. Off is the raw clip. ADAA1 uses the previous sample. ADAA2 uses two previous samples and falls back when the input is flat.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

offset.tooltip: Bias. The face edits this. Min, max, reverse, curve, and smooth time are Parameter Settings.

displaySource.tooltip: Mouse = pointer target. Smoothed = Bias after Parameter Settings smooth.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Min. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Max. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Min. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In Max. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet balance on the Mix outputs (not a wet-only path).

diffusionSize.tooltip: Longest diffusion delay line, in ms (each line gets a random fraction of it).

delaySize.tooltip: Length of the 2 main reverb delay taps, in ms.

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.

lfoAmplitude.tooltip: Delay modulation depth as a fraction of each line's own delay length (0.1 = each line swings by 10% of its length).

lfoBaseSpeed.tooltip: Delay modulation LFO rate in Hz (base rate; Mod(~)Vary slows some lines down).

lfoVariation.tooltip: Spread of modulation speed between delay lines: up to this many ms of extra LFO period per line. 0 = all lines modulate at the same speed.

lfoStyle.tooltip: Delay-time modulator. Parabol = original Sabrina cyclic wow. FBM = fractal Brownian flutter (same family as SoEm Reverb / Delay).

delayTapMod.tooltip: Modulation depth multiplier on the 2 main (non-diffuse) delay taps. 1 = original Sabrina, 0 = those taps hold a fixed length (diffusion keeps modulating), 2 = double depth.

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

darkness.tooltip: Maximum randomized rectangular pulse width. 1 = bright velvet noise; higher values = wider rectangular pulses for natural 6 dB/oct high-frequency damping.

tailDarkness.tooltip: Darkness at the end of the tail. The widest pulse grows from Darkness at the first tap to this at the last, so the tail gets darker as it goes, like a room where the highs die first. The tail's level stays set by Amp Decay; this only changes its colour. 0 = off (the whole tail uses Darkness).

stereoSpread.tooltip: 0% = identical L/R tap offsets (mono). 100% = independent L/R taps for decorrelated stereo.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for tap positions, signs, and pulse widths. Same seed = identical taps.

mode.tooltip: Pattern: up, dn, up/dn, dn/up, or random over Arp Keys.

rate.tooltip: Free-run step rate when Trigger and f are unconnected. Ignored whenever f is patched (external rate in Hz). Trigger edges always win over both.

steps.tooltip: Steps before pattern restart (esp. Random). 0 = natural wrap / free-run RNG.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for Random. Reset re-seeds from this value.

octaveOffset.tooltip: Transpose arpeggiated pitch by whole octaves (−4…+4). Applied to ♯/♭, ƒ, and inc outs.

sequenceOffset.tooltip: Rotate the pattern (including Random) by this many steps. Same seed, different offset → a shifted sequence.

gateLength.tooltip: How long Gate stays high, as a share of one step. 100% = legato (Gate never drops between steps). Lower = shorter notes; 0% = a one-sample gate. Step length comes from Rate / the f jack, or from the gap between Trigger edges when Trigger is patched (the first clocked step stays open).

rate.tooltip: Free-run step rate when Trigger and f are unconnected. Ignored whenever f is patched (external rate in Hz). Trigger edges always win over both.

steps.tooltip: Steps before pattern restart (esp. Random). 0 = natural wrap / free-run RNG.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for Random. Reset re-seeds from this value.

octaveOffset.tooltip: Transpose arpeggiated pitch by whole octaves (−4…+4). Applied to ♯/♭, ƒ, and inc outs.

sequenceOffset.tooltip: Rotate the pattern (including Random) by this many steps. Same seed, different offset → a shifted sequence.

gateLength.tooltip: How long Gate stays high, as a share of one step. 100% = legato (Gate never drops between steps). Lower = shorter notes; 0% = a one-sample gate. Step length comes from Rate / the f jack, or from the gap between Trigger edges when Trigger is patched (the first clocked step stays open).

octaves.tooltip: How many octaves of the chord Scale sends, starting at Root. 1 = one triad; 2 = Root and +12.

octaveOffset.tooltip: 0 = C3 (MIDI 60). Chord Pad C major root is C3 at offset 0.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

softenAttack.tooltip: 0…1 = Attack 0…0.02 s. KT (MIDI 0…127) unit-mods that span: −10% at 0, −41.25% at 127.

tail.tooltip: How long the pluck rings. Higher = longer. Inverted breadboard Dampen (0 = shortest, 2.2 = longest).

synthVsAcoustic.tooltip: DC offset on the inverted-env → expo → Release path. Higher = more acoustic linger.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: Latch: freeze Soften Attack on rising Trigger (release fold from Tail / Synth stays live). Free: knobs always live.

direction.tooltip: Forward / reverse speed. Adds to Speed: 0 no change, negative pushes toward reverse.

phase.tooltip: Fine scratch skip (−0.003…+0.003). 0.156 s Papoulis internal glide.

width.tooltip: Horizontal bow. 0 is flat. Positive bows the sides outward, like a CRT. Negative bows them inward.

height.tooltip: Vertical bow. 0 is flat. Positive bows the top and bottom outward. Negative bows them inward.

round.tooltip: Squircle screen edge. 0 is a sharp rectangle, around 0.7 a squircle, 1 an ellipse.

vignette.tooltip: Darkens the picture toward the edges of the glass. 0 is off, 1 goes all the way to black at the glass edge.

vigReach.tooltip: How far in from the edge the darkening starts. 0 hugs the corners, 1 darkens from the center.

vigCurve.tooltip: How sudden the vignette falls. 0 is a long soft gradient, 1 is a hard shadow edge. With Vignette at 1 the outside goes fully black.

vigShape.tooltip: The outline the vignette follows. 0 is an oval. 1 is the shape of the glass edge (see Roundness), so the dark follows the screen outline and, with Vignette at 1, reaches pure black exactly at the glass edge: no screen edge, just a soft shadow.

glareX.tooltip: Horizontal position of the glare. -1 left edge, 1 right edge.

glareY.tooltip: Vertical position of the glare. -1 bottom, 1 top.

glare.tooltip: A soft reflection on the glass and a faint sheen along its rim. 0 is off.

glareSize.tooltip: How big the glare spot is. 0 a small hot spot, 1 a broad wash.

shadowAlpha.tooltip: A shadow hugging the glass edge, like the enclosure casting onto the screen. How dark it gets at the edge. 0 is off, 1 is black. It follows the glass outline (Roundness).

shadowThick.tooltip: How far in from the glass edge the rim shadow reaches. It falls off softly into the picture.
